declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.FactorsThrough
declarations.statement_source: def FactorsThrough [Fintype ι] (F : Matrix α β ℝ) : Prop

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.FactorsThrough.rank_le
declarations.statement_source:
theorem FactorsThrough.rank_le [Fintype β] [Fintype ι]
    {F : Matrix α β ℝ} (h : FactorsThrough (ι := ι) F) :
    F.rank ≤ Fintype.card ι

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.polynomial_add_factorization
declarations.statement_source:
theorem polynomial_add_factorization (p : ℝ[X]) (d : ℕ)
    (hd : p.natDegree ≤ d) (u : α → ℝ) (v : β → ℝ) :
    FactorsThrough (ι := Fin (d + 1)) (fun x y => p.eval (u x + v y))

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.polynomial_add_rank_le
declarations.statement_source:
theorem polynomial_add_rank_le [Fintype β] (p : ℝ[X]) (d : ℕ)
    (hd : p.natDegree ≤ d) (u : α → ℝ) (v : β → ℝ) :
    Matrix.rank (fun x y => p.eval (u x + v y) : Matrix α β ℝ) ≤ d + 1

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.hermite_polynomial_add_rank_le
declarations.statement_source:
theorem hermite_polynomial_add_rank_le [Fintype β] (k : ℕ)
    (u : α → ℝ) (v : β → ℝ) :
    Matrix.rank (fun x y => (HermitePolynomial.sourceInterpolant k).eval (u x + v y) :
      Matrix α β ℝ) ≤ 2 * k + 2

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.product_factorization
declarations.statement_source:
theorem product_factorization (u : α → ℝ) (v : β → ℝ) :
    FactorsThrough (ι := Unit) (fun x y => u x * v y)

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.exponential_add_factorization
declarations.statement_source:
theorem exponential_add_factorization (u : α → ℝ) (v : β → ℝ) :
    FactorsThrough (ι := Unit) (fun x y => Real.exp (u x + v y))

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.FactorsThrough.add
declarations.statement_source:
theorem FactorsThrough.add [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {F G : Matrix α β ℝ} (hf : FactorsThrough (ι := ι) F)
    (hg : FactorsThrough (ι := κ) G) :
    FactorsThrough (ι := Sum ι κ) (fun x y => F x y + G x y)

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.FactorsThrough.neg
declarations.statement_source:
theorem FactorsThrough.neg [Fintype ι]
    {F : Matrix α β ℝ} (hf : FactorsThrough (ι := ι) F) :
    FactorsThrough (ι := ι) (fun x y => -F x y)

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.FactorsThrough.pointwise_mul
declarations.statement_source:
theorem FactorsThrough.pointwise_mul [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {F G : Matrix α β ℝ} (hf : FactorsThrough (ι := ι) F)
    (hg : FactorsThrough (ι := κ) G) :
    FactorsThrough (ι := ι × κ) (fun x y => F x y * G x y)

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.blockIndex_lt_iff
declarations.statement_source:
theorem blockIndex_lt_iff (M x y T : ℕ) (hy : y < M) :
    M * x + y < T ↔ x < T / M ∨ (x = T / M ∧ y < T % M)

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.threshold_factorization
declarations.statement_source:
theorem threshold_factorization (M T : ℕ) (u : α → ℕ) (v : β → ℕ)
    (hv : ∀ y, v y < M) :
    FactorsThrough (ι := Fin 2)
      (fun x y => if M * u x + v y < T then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.threshold_complement_factorization
declarations.statement_source:
theorem threshold_complement_factorization (M T : ℕ) (u : α → ℕ) (v : β → ℕ)
    (hv : ∀ y, v y < M) :
    FactorsThrough (ι := Fin 2)
      (fun x y => 1 - if M * u x + v y < T then (1 : ℝ) else 0)

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.affine_lt_cut
declarations.statement_source:
theorem affine_lt_cut (a h t : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (j : ℕ) :
    a + h * (j : ℝ) < t ↔ j < Nat.ceil ((t - a) / h)

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.smoothInitial_strict
declarations.statement_source:
theorem smoothInitial_strict (k : ℕ) (p : ℝ) :
    HermitePolynomial.smoothInitial k p =
      if p < -1 then Real.exp p else
        if p < 0 then (HermitePolynomial.sourceInterpolant k).eval p
        else Real.exp (-p)

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.HermiteBond
declarations.statement_source: abbrev HermiteBond (k : ℕ)

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.hermiteBond_card
declarations.statement_source: theorem hermiteBond_card (k : ℕ) : Fintype.card (HermiteBond k) = 8 * k + 12

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.hermite_affine_factorization
declarations.statement_source:
theorem hermite_affine_factorization (k M : ℕ) (a h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (u : α → ℕ) (v : β → ℕ) (hv : ∀ y, v y < M) :
    FactorsThrough (ι := HermiteBond k)
      (fun x y => HermitePolynomial.smoothInitial k
        (a + h * ((M * u x + v y : ℕ) : ℝ)))

declarations.name: QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteCutRank.hermite_affine_cut_rank_le
declarations.statement_source:
theorem hermite_affine_cut_rank_le [Fintype β] (k M : ℕ) (a h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (u : α → ℕ) (v : β → ℕ) (hv : ∀ y, v y < M) :
    Matrix.rank (fun x y => HermitePolynomial.smoothInitial k
      (a + h * ((M * u x + v y : ℕ) : ℝ))) ≤ 8 * k + 12
